from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545471/attempts/cb5c46cb9eb34b0fb84b0c3660206bd3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-8c353e26.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = grid[0][-1]
    # Identify uniform separator rows and column.
    sr = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    sc = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == sep for row in grid))
    bounds=[-1]+sr+[h]
    bands=[(bounds[i]+1,bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(bounds)-1) if bounds[i+1]>bounds[i]+1]
    special=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (sep, grid[0][0]))
    out=[]
    for a,b in bands:
        line=[]
        for x,y in ((0,sc),(sc+1,w)):
            n=sum(grid[r][c]==special for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y))
            line.append(1 if n>1 else grid[0][0])
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
